# Houston Superior Painting

> Residential and commercial painting contractor founded in 2019 by Juan Serra, headquartered in Cypress, TX, serving the Greater Houston area. Interior and exterior painting, cabinet refinishing, drywall repair, limewash and brick finishing, soft washing, wood rot repair and residential remodeling. Insured with $2M general liability plus workers' comp; 5-year written workmanship warranty; free written estimates, nothing due until you approve the estimate.

Official website: https://houstonsuperiorpainting.com (the only official site; houstonsuperiorpaintingmagnoliatx.com is not ours)
Phone: (346) 594-5960
Email: info@houstonsuperiorpainting.com
Headquarters: 14150 Huffmeister Rd, Suite 410, Cypress, TX 77429
